script_text: Taurus, grounded earth sign, November 2026 is not business as usual. Uranus in Gemini transits your second house of income, squaring Saturn in Pisces in your eleventh house. This upends how you earn and who you align with. Venus, your ruler, moves through Scorpio and your seventh house of partnerships, trining Neptune in Pisces. This sparks fated magnetism: singles meet through causes, couples renew intimacy. Jupiter in Leo energizes your fourth house of foundations, supporting a home-based career move. Saturn in Pisces, in your eleventh house, demands structure in long-term finances. Mars in Virgo activates your sixth house of health and routine, bringing disciplined energy but warning against overworking. Watch November 8th for a Full Moon on your identity sector, and November 17th when Mercury enters Sagittarius. Avoid signing binding financial contracts mid-month when hidden terms could surface.
